election.source_note: Bilt Rewards Card Offer Terms, last updated October 27, 2026 (bilt.com/terms/bilt-card-offer-terms), read by engineering on 2026-11-15 for ENG-02B; Argon to confirm against the published text. Credited on the account opening date (accounts opened on or after January 1, 2027) and on each Card Anniversary Date; for earlier accounts without a Legacy Election, from their first Card Anniversary Date on or after January 1, 2027; for a cardholder who leaves a Legacy Election, from the next Card Anniversary Date after the move. Never together with the legacy benefits. Card Anniversary Date: one year after the first day of the first Billing Cycle that begins after the Account Open Date, then the same day each year. anniversary_cycle_days 62 is an engineering allowance for where that day can fall, NOT a published figure; anniversary_on on the holding replaces it.
